name: Super Mario War
description:
Super Mario War is an open-source, fan-made multiplayer deathmatch game set in the Super Mario universe. Players battle in competitive 2D arena platforming matches by stomping on each other's heads.

Features:
- Frenetic 4-player local multiplayer action with customizable AI bots
- Over 1,000 community-created multiplayer arenas and custom game modes
- Classic power-ups including Fire Flowers, Tanooki Suits, shells, and Bob-ombs
- Multiple match types: Deathmatch, Capture the Flag, Coin Collection, and Boss Battles
- Built-in level editor and character skin customization system
